The primary star is a neutron star with a sweeping pulsar beam and a research station in orbit
A starless nebula system: thick nebula everywhere, no central star
Extra asteroid belts and fields, whose rocks strike fleets passing through, with caches hidden in the belts
Magnetic fields around the star and several worlds that blind sensors
Every corona throws flares constantly
A growing tear into hyperspace: drains, breach caches and every fleet in the system charging it
Two factions fight over a border system; the player sides with one or stays out
A dormant nav buoy, comm relay and sensor array; waking all three moves the network on to a harder, richer system
A friendly armed convoy runs a visible route to a planet; beat it for its fleet loot and cargo pods, or raid the cache it delivers (80% of its Exiled Sector loot and cargo)
Debris fields hiding dormant AI-core fleets that wait for the player to strike; corrupting one first drops an engram
AI War bolt-holes under some planets, each with its own items: an open shaft is a fight between frigates and destroyers only, a collapsed one a marine raid
An ion storm front crosses the system on a visible path; battles inside it are struck by lightning and drop more items
A Domain nanoforge on a derelict station runs a few precise programs on hull items for metals, rare metals and Nanite Feedstock
A faction depot with a vault of weapons, parts and blueprints behind a ring of sensor pickets; reach it unseen for the whole vault, or raise the alarm and watch the garrison scuttle it
